posts.text: ADHD burnout isn’t from doing too much. It’s from fighting your own brain all day.
People think ADHD means “distracted.” It actually means “I can’t do boring things unless they’re fun or on fire.”
ADHD isn’t about control—it’s about working with your rhythm. You feel this too?
Why finish one project when you can start four new ones?
You learn to perform, not process. That’s how ADHD hides in our culture. Relatable?
I don’t skip workouts—I just forget they existed. Anyone else? Relatable?
